job.job_description:
Skill- GenAI Developer




Experience- 3 to 10 Years

Role




1. Gen AI Developer ( Mandatory Skil- Any Cloud experience like AWS/GCP/Azure/ and having experience in AI, LLM,ML,RAG)

2. Gen AI Lead ( Mandatory Skil- Any Cloud experience like AWS/GCP/Azure/ and having experience in AI Architect, LLM,ML,RAG)

Role Overview

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Cloud Application Architect / Lead Engineer with strong hands-on experience across AWS, Azure, and GCP. The role focuses on architecting, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade cloud-native applications, including web and mobile applications, with deep exposure to Kubernetes, ecosystem deployments, and AI-driven application architectures.

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Cloud Infra, particularly for custom applications and database-centric workloads, while also contributing to modern AI/LLM-based solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy cloud-native applications across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Lead application architecture, migration, and modernization initiatives.
Architect and deploy web and mobile applications with scalability, resiliency, and security best practices.
Design, implement, and operate containerized platforms using Docker and Kubernetes.
Deploy, configure, and manage custom applications on Cloud Infra, including integrations with multi-cloud environments.
Work closely with database teams on DB architecture, performance tuning, and cloud-native DB services.
Design and implement AI-enabled applications and agent-based architectures.
Apply Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns in enterprise AI solutions.
Collaborate with DevOps, Security, and Platform teams to ensure CI/CD, observability, and governance standards.
Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior engineers and teams.

Cloud Platforms

Strong hands-on experience with:
AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform
